events.title: 쿠카르카에서 태어나다
events.description_en: He was born in Kukarka, in Vyatka Governorate, Russia.

events.title: 볼셰비키에 가입하다
events.description: 열여섯 나이로 볼셰비키에 가입해 혁명 활동을 시작했다.
events.description_en: At sixteen he joined the Bolsheviks and began his career in revolutionary politics.

events.title: 프라우다 편집에 참여하며 혁명에 뛰어들다
events.title_en: He edited Pravda and threw himself into the revolution
events.description: 당 기관지 프라우다 편집에 참여하며 10월 혁명 조직 작업에 힘을 보탰다.
events.description_en: He worked on the party newspaper Pravda and helped organize the October Revolution.

events.title: 정치국 정회원이 되다
events.title_en: He became a full member of the Politburo
events.description: 소련 공산당 정치국 정회원에 올라 스탈린의 핵심 측근으로 자리 잡았다.
events.description_en: He became a full member of the Politburo, cementing his place as one of Stalin's closest allies.

events.title: 인민위원회의 의장이 되다
events.title_en: He became chairman of the Council of People's Commissars
events.description: 소련 정부 수반 격인 인민위원회의 의장에 올라 1941년까지 이 자리를 지켰다.
events.description_en: He rose to chairman of the Council of People's Commissars, effectively the Soviet Union's premier, a post he held until 1941.

events.title: 외무인민위원이 되다
events.title_en: He became People's Commissar for Foreign Affairs
events.description: 스탈린이 리트비노프를 대신해 그를 외무인민위원에 앉혔다. 서방과의 집단안보 노선을 접고 독일과 손잡을 신호였다.
events.description_en: Stalin replaced Litvinov with him as commissar of foreign affairs, signaling a shift away from collective security with the West and toward a deal with Germany.

events.title: 독소 불가침조약에 서명하다
events.description: 독일 외무장관 리벤트로프와 불가침조약에 서명했다. 비밀의정서로 동유럽을 양국 세력권으로 나누는 내용이 포함되어 있었다.
events.description_en: He signed the non-aggression pact with German foreign minister Ribbentrop. A secret protocol carved Eastern Europe into spheres of influence between the two powers.

events.title: 테헤란·얄타·포츠담 회담에 참석하다
events.title_en: He attended the Tehran, Yalta, and Potsdam conferences
events.description: 독일의 소련 침공 이후 영국·미국과 상호원조조약을 맺고, 연합국 정상회담인 테헤란·얄타·포츠담 회담에 잇달아 참석했다.
events.description_en: After Germany invaded the Soviet Union, he negotiated mutual-aid treaties with Britain and the United States and attended the Allied summits at Tehran, Yalta, and Potsdam.

events.title: 스탈린의 눈 밖에 나고 아내가 끌려가다
events.title_en: He fell from Stalin's favor as his wife was taken away
events.description: 외무장관 자리에서 밀려났다. 같은 시기 아내 폴리나 젬추지나가 유대 민족주의자와 접촉했다는 혐의로 체포되어 강제이혼과 수용소행을 겪었다.
events.description_en: He was pushed out of the foreign ministry. Around the same time his wife, Polina Zhemchuzhina, was arrested on charges of contact with Jewish nationalists, forced into divorce from him, and sent to a labor camp.

events.title: 스탈린 사후 외무장관에 복귀하다
events.title_en: He returned as foreign minister after Stalin's death
events.description: 스탈린이 죽자 외무장관에 복귀했고, 아내도 풀려나 복권됐다.
events.description_en: After Stalin's death he returned to the foreign ministry, and his wife was released and rehabilitated as well.

events.title: 반당 그룹으로 몰려 실각하다
events.title_en: He was purged as part of the Anti-Party Group
events.description: 흐루쇼프의 스탈린 격하 노선에 맞서다 반당 그룹으로 몰려 모든 요직에서 쫓겨났다. 이후 몽골 대사로 좌천됐다.
events.description_en: He opposed Khrushchev's de-Stalinization and was branded part of the Anti-Party Group, losing all his major posts. He was then demoted to ambassador to Mongolia.

events.title: 공산당에서 제명되다
events.title_en: He was expelled from the Communist Party
events.description: 스탈린 옹호를 굽히지 않은 끝에 공산당에서 완전히 제명됐다.
events.description_en: Still refusing to renounce Stalin, he was expelled outright from the Communist Party.

events.title: 아흔셋에 당에 복권되다
events.title_en: He was reinstated in the party at ninety-three
events.description: 체르넨코 시절 아흔셋의 나이로 다시 공산당원 자격을 되찾았다.
events.description_en: Under Chernenko he regained his Communist Party membership at the age of ninety-three.

events.title: 모스크바에서 죽다
events.description: 모스크바에서 아흔여섯에 죽었다. 죽는 날까지 흐루쇼프를 비롯한 스탈린 후계자들을 비판했다.
events.description_en: He died in Moscow at ninety-six, having criticized Khrushchev and Stalin's other successors to the end.
